artist.name: Aneesha Kotwani
artist.bio: Aneesha Kotwani is a Mumbai-based radio presenter and the founder of WAVLNGTH, a music agency she started in 2016 that works on touring, artist management, radio and content. She moved to the UK in 2009, returned to India in 2013, and has presented shows on BBC Asian Network, Soho Radio, Worldwide FM and boxout.fm.
